BLOCKER: AC-mandated fresh-install case ("empty audit, setval to 1") has no test in the diff, and 0014 §17 computes `GREATEST(0, last_value=1)+1 = 2`, so the shadow sequence starts at 2, not 1 — untested, unverified divergence from the stated AC.
MAJOR: `AuditStore.Append` passes `e.At` verbatim with no `now()` fallback: a zero-value or >horizon timestamp that the flat table previously accepted now fails 23514 after 3 retries — live audit writes can start failing in production.

`pfaudit-swap backup` can deadlock: if `obj.Put` returns early (e.g. SSE rejected by the adapter), the `io.Pipe` reader is never closed, `age`/`pg_dump` block writing, and `dump.Wait()` hangs with no timeout or kill.

Retention is not resumable after a partial export: `audit_mark_archived` is committed before the partition drop; if the drop fails the month stays a candidate, re-export fails "already archived", the cron `fail()`s and all later months are wedged until manual repair.

Legal-hold integrity: `0014 down` drops `audit_legal_hold_events` whenever the archive table is empty (holds on empty/released months), erasing the record that a hold ever existed; Go `--down --force-with-reason` likewise proceeds with active holds.

Fragile error-string coupling: `PlaceHold` detects spoliation via `strings.Contains(err,"purged")` and purge-blocking via `"active legal hold"` — a SQL message rewording silently disables `ErrHoldAfterPurge`/`audit_hold_after_purge_total` and `MetricPurgeBlockedHold`.
Applied migration `0004` was edited in place (role-existence guard); this breaks migration immutability and will show as checksum drift on checksum-tracking runners.
AC requires the resume path be exercised by a Postgres-16 integration suite; the tests only gate on `server_version >= 14` and no PG16 CI wiring appears in the diff.

Append-only guarantee is incomplete for privileged roles: no TRUNCATE deny trigger on the monthly leaves and `pf_owner` is not revoked TRUNCATE on partitions, so an owner-level `TRUNCATE` of a leaf bypasses the journal protection.
MINOR: `MetricSwapFreeze` is measured from before `pool.Acquire` and includes lock waits/retries, overstating the ACCESS EXCLUSIVE window it is compared against `PF_AUDIT_FREEZE_BUDGET_SECONDS`.
A rejected spoliation attempt leaves no durable DB record (the RAISE rolls back its own journal insert); only a process-local metric survives.
`backup()` prefers the `pg_dump` error over `putErr`, masking the real object-store failure cause.
`RestoreMonth`'s scratch inherits `nextval('audit_id_seq')`; a forensic insert into it advances the live sequence.
Retention cron uses `${PF_OPERATOR:-retention}`, but cron.d does not import `/etc/environment` without PAM; the recorded actor may silently be "retention".
